text:
Aisha: Planning run-through for CipherLock + SI joint launch. Need final checks for SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, KMS/HSM demo, and embargo timing.
Tom: Security items: SAML metadata + cert rotation steps. Also confirm HSM attestation doc and demo key lifecycle.
Devon: Engineering: wrapped-key flow in staging is live. Demo command: `rlwrap cipherwrap --key ck-demo --in creds.json`. Will add small API shim for UI. Need a service principal with scim:read,kms:wrap.
Marta: Product: demo flow = SSO login -> SCIM auto-provision -> request wrapped secret -> rotate key -> verify audit log. Keep demo under 90s. Fallback: use pre-wrapped blob if HSM not reachable.
Leo: Marketing embargo target = 2026-04-14. Assets due 2026-04-11. Need short clip + 3 screenshots (SSO, SCIM groups, KMS console).
Devon: SCIM note: delta sync disabled in staging, I can enable. Example SCIM object we'll use: `{"displayName":"cipher-admins","members":[{"value":"devon@redwood.com"}]}`.
Tom: Ops: keep audit logs 30 days for demo accounts and ensure console shows key operations. Also demo manual key rotation then automated rotation.
CipherLock-bot: vendor: dropping temporary test key and short-lived creds tomorrow; attestation PDF will be shared.
Aisha: Action items: (1) Vendor uploads creds+attestation (CipherLock) (2) Tom posts SAML metadata + rotation runbook (Tom) (3) Devon creates demo principal + enables SCIM delta (Devon) (4) Marta+Leo produce clip+screenshots (Marta/Leo) (5) Ops ensures log retention (Ops). Everyone ack?
Marta: Ack, starting storyboard.
Tom: Ack, will upload by EOD.
Devon: Ack, will provision principal and enable delta tomorrow AM.
Leo: Ack, marketing timeline noted.
ops-bot: snapshot-scheduler: demo env snapshot scheduled 2026-04-09T03:00:00Z.
Aisha: Suggest 15m legal pre-check on embargo wording Tue — anyone object?
Tom: Agree, legal should sign off on HSM/FIPS claims.
Aisha: I'll send the invite and attach the checklist. :thumbsup:
